results.rationale: Consistency: Phone placement, outline and overall camera arrangement remain, but the lens interiors/rims and small sensor appearance change, a conspicuous vertical marking appears on the lower back, and fine vegetation textures are redrawn. Excluding the requested body recoloring, multiple details differ. Instruction: The white body becomes black; the expected result is this same phone with a black casing, and the visible casing is fully black, so the color request is fulfilled. Quality, edited image only: Structure and natural lighting are satisfactory, with coherent casing edges and dry stems; artifact/text fidelity is problematic because the lower-right marking contains malformed, ambiguous glyphs, a clear localized flaw.

Instruction: The previously white casing is now black across its back and camera housing, matching the expected black version of the same phone; compliance is complete.
